# Prevent git from modifying image files
*.png binary
*.jpg binary
*.jpeg binary
*.gif binary
*.webp binary
*.ico binary

# Preserve line endings for text files
*.ts text eol=lf
*.tsx text eol=lf
*.js text eol=lf
*.jsx text eol=lf
*.json text eol=lf
*.md text eol=lf
